n: The elders who were preaching should continue preaching and encouraging nearby branches until the upcoming conference (held in Amherst, Ohio, later that January).
At the conference, their individual missions will be announced.

f.w: by the voice of the conference

n: Joseph and Sidney should resume translating the Bible.

f.g: Joseph Smith’s inspired revision of the Bible (the JST), paused in December 1831.

n: Where practical, they should preach until the conference, then continue translating until finished. The main work was completed in July 1833.
This is a pattern for the elders until further instruction.
No more for now. Prepare for action and be serious.

f.w: Gird up your loins and be sober
